title: Nashville's Wildest Honky Tonk on Wheels Private Party Bus
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We are Nashville's first "Official Party Bus" of Nashville. We allow for guests of up-to 25 people to have a private party on our open-air party bus. 

During your two hour tour, you will see numerous sites of downtown Broadway as your party your way through Nashville. Each tour comes complete with a monster sound system, VIP bartender, LED lights, a bar, and the best damn party on wheels!
